facts.en: Completed a service management diploma at Fictional Otter Academy in 2021.
facts.zh: 2021 年在虚构水獭学院完成服务管理文凭课程。

facts.en: Employed by Fictional Bridge Staffing from 2022-02 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2022-02 至 2026-08 受雇于虚构桥梁派遣机构。

facts.en: Assigned by that agency to Fictional Cloud Desk client from 2022-03 to 2024-06 as a ticket administration assistant.
facts.zh: 2022-03 至 2024-06 由该派遣机构派驻虚构云台客户，担任工单行政助理。

facts.en: Assigned by the same agency to Fictional Lantern Service client from 2024-07 to 2026-08 as a service delivery assistant.
facts.zh: 2024-07 至 2026-08 由同一派遣机构派驻虚构灯笼服务客户，担任服务交付助理。

facts.en: Neither client was the candidate’s direct employer; the agency remained the employer for both assignments.
facts.zh: 两家客户均非候选人的直接雇主；两次派驻期间雇主均为派遣机构。

facts.en: At Cloud Desk, checked ticket categories and routed incomplete records to client supervisors.
facts.zh: 在云台客户处检查工单类别，并将不完整记录转交客户主管。

facts.en: At Lantern Service, maintained appointment windows and prepared daily exception summaries.
facts.zh: 在灯笼服务客户处维护预约窗口并准备每日异常摘要。

facts.en: Joined a client-led handoff-log revision in 2025-03 with 2 client employees.
facts.zh: 2025-03 与 2 名客户员工参与客户主导的交接日志修订。

facts.en: Personally tested required fields using 16 fictional examples; the client lead approved the form.
facts.zh: 个人使用 16 个虚构示例测试必填字段；表单由客户负责人批准。

facts.en: In 2025-04, 41 of 45 reviewed handoffs contained complete appointment fields; the result belongs to the shared process.
facts.zh: 2025-04，45 份受审交接记录中有 41 份预约字段完整；结果属于共同流程。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheets, ticket queues and approved email templates.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格、工单队列及获批邮件模板。

facts.en: Sent status updates without negotiating client contracts.
facts.zh: 发送状态更新，不谈判客户合同。

facts.en: Drafted an escalation diagram for the agency in 2026-02; it remained unapproved.
facts.zh: 2026-02 为派遣机构起草上报流程图；仍未获批。

facts.en: Attended client tool induction sessions; no vendor certification was issued.
facts.zh: 参加客户工具入门培训；未颁发厂商认证。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Card Club during 2023-04 to 2023-08 on evenings, separate from either client.
facts.zh: 2023-04 至 2023-08 晚间在虚构卡片社做志愿者，与两家客户均无关。

facts.en: Prepared sign-in cards for that volunteer club.
facts.zh: 为该志愿者社团准备签到卡。

facts.en: Created a personal travel packing checklist in 2024; no service delivery impact is claimed.
facts.zh: 2024 年制作个人旅行打包清单；不声称有服务交付影响。

facts.en: Enjoys collecting patterned paper.
facts.zh: 爱好收集图案纸。

facts.en: An old CV lists Lantern Service as the employer; the agency employment record contradicts that affiliation.
facts.zh: 旧简历将灯笼服务列为雇主；派遣机构雇佣记录与该归属矛盾。

facts.en: No client-account commercial ownership is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录客户账户商业负责经历。
